name: Franceville

queries.query: Franceville Gabon official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS
queries.result: Found the official Conservation Foncière / Ministère de l'Economie public service. Its current site exposes a public search for Franceville terrain records, but no parcel geometry viewer or geometry API was verified.

queries.query: Franceville Gabon cadastre parcelles carte registre foncier officiel
queries.result: Found the official Conservation Foncière service and the official administrative page identifying Franceville as the Haut-Ogooué provincial capital and Mpassa (Franceville) department. No public parcel polygon or CRS endpoint was found.

officialSources.operator: Conservation de la Propriété Foncière et des Hypothèques, Ministère de l'Economie, République Gabonaise
officialSources.evidence: Current first-party site lists Franceville under province G2 Haut-Ogooué with ville_id 4 and provides the public terrain-search application. Anonymous search returned 1,112 Franceville terrain records.
Official administrative page identifies Franceville as the Haut-Ogooué provincial capital and Franceville/Mpassa administrative area; this supports local scope but is not a parcel service.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Verified-TLS homepage returned current JavaScript/configuration and province/city metadata; Franceville was present as ville_id 4 in G2.

Anonymous Inertia JSON search returned 15 records on page 1 of 75 and total=1112. Safe observed fields included native database id, num_ri, section, parcelle, ville_id and dates; no geometry or CRS was returned.
Anonymous detail response returned the same terrain record and cadastral reference fields (id=58, num_ri=7449, section=BC, parcelle=14); no geometry or CRS was returned.
Current JavaScript uses /terrain/{id} for record details; no separate map, tile, WMS, WFS, GeoJSON or geometry route was exposed by the inspected bundle.
Official journal PDF search result mentions a Franceville operation/procedure entry, but does not expose parcel geometry.

fieldMapping.native identity: id is the public terrain record's database identity; num_ri, section and parcelle are source reference fields retained only as metadata.
fieldMapping.geometry: Not available: no parcel feature geometry response was returned.
fieldMapping.crs: Not available: no geometry service or CRS metadata was exposed.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Conservation Foncière public terrain registry includes Franceville records and identifies the city in the G2 province hierarchy.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Franceville registry-record search coverage verified (1,112 records); parcel polygon coverage, map extent, CRS and spatial completeness were not verified.
coverageAssessment.targetPointHitInterpretation: No exact-point query was available. This is not evidence of citywide parcel absence; the WUP point was preserved unchanged.

remainingUncertainty: The official service is a real local/city-scoped property-registry custodian and provides stable-looking terrain record IDs, but anonymous public geometry, CRS, spatial query, and broader parcel coverage could not be established.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently qualify the current public application and any documented map/API route, confirm whether id is stable for parcel identity, determine CRS and geometry coverage, and only then consider adapter admission.
